The term
Λ-Body (Lambda-Body) can refer to a conceptual/artistic archive concept or a biological/medical component related to the immune system.
1. The Crimson Hexagon Archive Concept

* Definition: "The Λ-Body" is an entry and room (`R:r.36`) within the Crimson Hexagonal Archive (curated via Alexanarch Archive). [1, 2]
* Core Idea: It describes an "anchored body organised not by present stimulus but by future coherence," exploring embodiment and meaning-production in a conceptual or speculative framework. [1]

2. Biological and Medical Context (Lambda Light Chains)

* Definition: In immunology, lambda refers to one of the two major types of light chains (along with kappa) that combine with heavy chains to form antibodies (immunoglobulins). [1, 2]
* Free Light Chains: Unbound lambda or kappa light chains circulate in the blood and are measured via a Mayo Clinic Free Light Chain Test. [1, 2]
* Clinical Significance: An abnormal ratio or elevated lambda level on a serum test can indicate plasma cell disorders such as multiple myeloma, MGUS, or amyloidosis. [1, 2]
